decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models aligned to the firm's stated direction, its strategic option value remains high and there is no evidence yet that its value is unlikely.
The organic poultry snack has its own page and remains a low-cost option in a growing organic segment, so uncertainty still favors keeping it open.
The premium sharing snack is close to the established offer, has several models, and shows enough ongoing support to justify keeping the option open.
